senses.gloss:
धुवन, अस्, m., Ved. fire; (अम्), n. shaking,
agitation; place of execution.

धुवित्र, अम्, n. a sort of fan (made of deer-skin
and especially used to kindle or excite a sacrificial
fire); [cf. धवित्र.]

धुवका धुवका, f. the introductory stanza
of a song, forming afterwards the burden of each
verse; [cf. ध्रुवका.]
